system.name: OTTER
system.one_liner: a multi-WAN transport system for 5G that co-optimizes which NF/application compute serves a flow and the route that flow takes to it

components.name: Network APIs
components.role: standardized Quality-on-Demand APIs through which applications submit 5G flow demands (identifiers and QoS profile)

components.name: Controller
components.role: co-optimizes which 5G application/NF compute serves a flow and the route to it; allocates compute and calculates network paths within capacity limits

components.name: Optimizer
components.role: issues SQL queries for sliding-window path metrics (throughput, RTT, jitter, loss) and solves the placement/routing LP using the Gurobi solver

components.name: Orchestrator
components.role: manages cloud resources and implements the forwarding mechanism to steer traffic along Controller-computed routes; provisions compute per the optimal placement

components.name: Profile Database
components.role: stores performance measurements queried by the Optimizer for sliding-window path metrics

components.name: Measurement Coordinator
components.role: automates periodic execution of measurement tools (iPerf3, sockperf) for path bandwidth, RTT, jitter, and loss

components.name: sources
components.role: traffic sources in the operator WAN

components.name: operator edge
components.role: edge compute site in the operator WAN available for compute placement

components.name: cloud edge
components.role: edge compute site in the cloud WAN available for compute placement

components.name: cloud DC
components.role: datacenter compute site in the cloud WAN available for compute placement

components.name: operator WAN
components.role: the operator's wide-area network; one of the two WANs OTTER places flows and compute across

components.name: cloud WAN
components.role: the cloud provider's wide-area network; the other WAN OTTER places flows and compute across

flows.what: an example flow path from a source to allocated cloud compute
an alternate/measured network path between the cloud and operator WANs

summary: OTTER is a system that places 5G flows across a multi-WAN environment by co-optimizing which application/NF compute serves a flow and the route to reach it. Figure 4 shows OTTER's architecture as a control-plane pipeline above a data-plane panel. Network APIs deliver 5G flow demands, and a Profile Database supplies performance history, both feeding the Controller, whose embedded Optimizer computes placement and routes; the Controller passes flow allocations to the Orchestrator, which provisions cloud resources and steers traffic. A Measurement Coordinator periodically measures network paths and writes performance measurements back to the Profile Database. Below, a dashed panel depicts the two WANs OTTER spans: an operator WAN (with traffic sources and an operator edge site) and a cloud WAN (with a cloud edge and a cloud DC), linked by an example flow path and a measured or alternate path.
